details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or pipeline phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate, and so on). Please name it in an `/answer` reply. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific script, prompt or test under `scripts/`, `prompts/` or `tests/`. Please name the file.
C. Documentation only (README.md, docs/, or an agents.d/ fragment).
D. No concrete target; this issue was filed by mistake or as a test and should be closed.
Q2: What does "better" mean for that target?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure. Please add the failing run, error message or reproduction steps. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a specific new behaviour or feature. Please describe the expected behaviour.
C. Improve performance or cost, or reduce API/model usage. Please name the metric and the goal.
D. Make it clearer or more robust without changing behaviour (docs, logging, tests).
